page.layout: Running head at top with page number at the left; two medallion engravings side by side at the top; below them one column of running text in two paragraphs, full width. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: THEOPHILVS Michaëlis Balbi filius, post patrem imperat Constantinopoli anno mundi 4792. à Christo nato 830. Hic erga subditos iustum ac æquum se præstitit, diuorū autem imagines execratus est, eorúmque cultores acriter puniuit, patrem imitatus. Cum Saracenis Asiæ provincias vastantibus, bis congressus, bis victus est, castrísque exutus. Amorium, unde illi genus, ab iis obsessum, ac proditione captum, direptū est. inde ob animi mœrorē ab omni cibo ille abstinēs, solámque aquam frigidam potans, in dysenteriam incidit, qua periit post annum imperij decimumquintum. Vide ut supra, in huius Imperatoris patre.

MICHAEL Theophili filius, successit patri adhuc infans, & sub tutela matris Theodorae, quae pro filio imperiū administrauit Constantinopolitanum anno mundi 4807. à Christo nato 845. Michaël autem adolescentiam ubi attigit, regni negocia tractare coepit, cefsitq; ei mater. Hic auo quàm patri similior, per ignauiam ac prodigalitate rem afflixit: irruetibus subinde multis bellis, à cursu equorū in quem omne studium collocarat, auocari non potuit. Circēfibus itaque ludis dum plus nimio indulget, Basilium Macedonē Barda interfecto consortem imperij ascivit: à quo mox occisus est, cùm imperasset annis tredecim. Vide Blondum lib.2. Deca.2. Baptist. Egna.lib.Ro.principum 2.& Cosmog.Mun.lib.4.

page.notes: Two medallion engravings above the text, not transcribed as text. Left: Theophilus, crowned and bearded, with legend fragments "LVS." and "THEOPHI" around the rim. Right: Michael and Theodora, laureate and facing, with legend "MICHAEL T THEODORA AVG" around the rim. Long s printed as s throughout. The word "collocarat" is split across a line end without a hyphen and is written whole. The Greek-free text contains no doubtful readings beyond "auo" and "irruetibus", copied as printed.
